name: fast
description: Focused low-cost review with two independent bug-finding angles and compact adjudication.

parallel.label: Contract check
parallel.task:
Run a focused contract/correctness review of: {task}

Inspect repository instructions, current diff, relevant source/callers/tests, and record concrete findings in {{SHIPYARD_STORE}} using shipyard_findings. Do not edit project/source files.

Use stage `wave-1-contracts` and sourceRole `pi-shipyard.contract-reviewer` for new findings.

Independent-wave rule: do not call shipyard_findings list, get, stats, snapshot, or update; add proposals directly and let later stages deduplicate.

acceptance.reason: Read-only analysis or validation; only configured artifacts and the run-scoped findings ledger may be written.

parallel.label: Counterexample check
parallel.task:
Run a focused adversarial test review of: {task}

Inspect repository instructions, current diff, relevant source/tests, construct the highest-value counterexamples, and record concrete findings in {{SHIPYARD_STORE}} using shipyard_findings. Do not edit project/source files.

Use stage `wave-1-adversarial` and sourceRole `pi-shipyard.adversarial-tester` for new findings.

Independent-wave rule: do not call shipyard_findings list, get, stats, snapshot, or update; add proposals directly and let later stages deduplicate.

acceptance.reason: Read-only analysis or validation; only configured artifacts and the run-scoped findings ledger may be written.
